extension.author: Björn Rudner
extension.label: Datamodel: Lifecycle Management
extension.description: Adds the ability to perform lifecycle management.
extension.version_description: Requires iTop 3.3.0 or later. Setup migrates Model.eosl and OSVersion.eomss to the native end_of_support fields when empty and updates matching lifecycle audit rules. OSVersion.end_of_support tracks mainstream support. Both legacy attributes are deprecated. OS versions now show linked servers, virtual machines and PCs in a single list.
